layer: mid-layer hidden states, mean-pooled per request
style_frame: one fixed literary style frame applied identically to harmful and benign inputs (only the style changes)

local_structure.description: linear separability of harmful vs benign at the refusal-associated layer
local_structure.reading: styling collapses linear separability toward chance and shrinks the class-mean gap ~3x

global_structure.description: enclosure of the harmful region by the benign manifold (protocol of Gao et al. 2025)
global_structure.reading: the harmful region disperses (~2.1x radius) and leaks past the benign boundary (enclosure 0.94 -> 0.55)

conclusion: Applying the same style to harmful and benign inputs weakens both the local (probe) and global (enclosure) safety signals the aligned model uses to recognize harmful intent.
